verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an agent and workflow framework, for example batch or foreach processing across many items, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no documented bulk or batch capability. The only related items are the workflow `.parallel()` control-flow primitive and background task execution. These are developer building blocks for running steps concurrently, not a bulk operation across many items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
